```python
def slug(text):
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace runs of non-ASCII letters/digits with a single hyphen
    result = ""
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i].isalnum():
            result += text[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            # Skip all non-alphanumeric characters and add a single hyphen
            if result and result[-1] != '-':
                result += '-'
            i += 1
    # Strip edge hyphens
    if result and result[0] == '-':
        result = result[1:]
    if result and result[-1] == '-':
        result = result[:-1]
    return result
```
